t: Nothing of Montagu House survives, but it once stood near the southwest corner of Greenwich Park, overlooking Blackheath common, beside what is now the Ranger's House. It was a prominent residence, commissioned by Ralph Montagu, the first Duke of Montagu, an English courtier, diplomat and politician. It later became the royal residence of Caroline of Brunswick. The house was demolished in 1815, so what you see here now is the edge of the park and the open heath that it once looked out over.
